insight: Psalm 46:1 and Psalm 145:18 both emphasize God's immediate and reliable presence in times of need. Psalm 46:1 declares God as a refuge and a very present help in trouble, highlighting His active protection and strength amid repeated crises. Similarly, Psalm 145:18 affirms that the LORD is near to all who sincerely call upon Him, underscoring God's relational availability and faithful response to genuine prayer. Together, these verses affirm that God's power and presence are both steadfast and accessible to those who earnestly seek Him in truth.
